Xingyu Lai is an interdisciplinary artist from China, based in Chicago. Painting forms the foundation of her practice, which also encompasses sculpture, ceramics, photography, and interactive installation. Her work explores how bodily sensation, memory, and emotion shape an individual's experience of the world. She attends to the ways feelings persist through time, familiar surroundings become psychologically distant, and vulnerability remains intertwined with vitality.

Her recent paintings move further toward abstraction, continuing her inquiry into an inner life that remains fluid, sensitive, and resistant to fixed definitions. She is interested in the threshold where recognition becomes uncertain but sensation intensifies. As identifiable forms recede, she considers how a presence can still be felt, seeking to make intimate experiences perceptible without fully defining them.

赖星羽是一位来自中国、现居芝加哥的跨学科艺术家。她的创作以绘画为基础，也涵盖雕塑、陶瓷、摄影与互动装置。她探索身体感知、记忆与情绪如何塑造个体对世界的体验，关注感受在时间中的延续、熟悉环境中的心理距离，以及脆弱与生命力的交织。

她近期的绘画进一步走向抽象，持续探索流动、敏锐且难以被固定定义的内在生命。她关注视觉辨认变得不确定、感受却愈加鲜明的临界状态，探寻形象逐渐退隐之后，一种存在如何仍能被感知。她希望让私密的内在经验变得可感，同时保留其中难以言明的部分。
